r/beermoney 拿到了——**年入 3 万美元的 beermoney 复盘**、**5 周 $4500 的用户访谈**、**Dscout $563**。抓关键原帖全文。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 400000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function parseEntries(xml){",
 " return xml.split('<entry>').slice(1).map(function(e){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
 " let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
 " return {title:title, body:body};",
 " });",
 "}",
 "(async function(){",
 " console.log('等待 100 秒...');",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,100000)});",
 " const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/beermoney/top/.rss?t=year');",
 " console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " const es=parseEntries(r.body);",
 " // 找年入 30k 和 4500 那两条",
 " for(const e of es){",
 " if(/30k this year/i.test(e.title) || /4500/.test(e.body) || /Dscout/i.test(e.title)){",
 " console.log('\\n========== '+e.title+' ==========');",
 " console.log(e.body.substring(0,4500));",
 " }",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bm.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bm.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch full beermoney case posts", timeoutMs: 350000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 14000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function parseEntries(xml){",
  "  return xml.split('<entry>').slice(1).map(function(e){",
  "    const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "    const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "    const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
  "    let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
  "    return {title:title, body:body};",
  "  });",
  "}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  console.log('等待 100 秒...');",
  "  await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,100000)});",
  "  const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/beermoney/top/.rss?t=year');",
  "  console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
  "  const es=parseEntries(r.body);",
  "  // 找年入 30k 和 4500 那两条",
  "  for(const e of es){",
  "    if(/30k this year/i.test(e.title) || /4500/.test(e.body) || /Dscout/i.test(e.title)){",
  "      console.log('\\n========== '+e.title+' ==========');",
  "      console.log(e.body.substring(0,4500));",
  "    }",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bm.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bm.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch full beermoney case posts", timeoutMs: 350000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 14000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
